messages:
nolans: FYI payment for Vistara Health invoice INV-2573 just failed with 'issuer_restricted'. Customer reached out — they say their card worked elsewhere.

maria-ops: Got the decline code, thanks. Do we have last4 and gateway error id?

nolans: last4 4242, gateway id gw_9a3b. Amount $12,450. No 3DS on file.

samir: Looks like an issuer-level block. We can queue an immediate retry but after 3 failed attempts gateway will lock. Do we want to try manual retry now or request bank transfer?

elena-sales: Customer says they can do bank transfer if needed — wants to avoid churn. Do we have wire instructions to send?

maria-ops: We have a standard wire template. For >$10k we need finance lead approval to accept wire. Paging @kevin-legal for any compliance flags.

kevin-legal: No legal issues with the transfer itself. Confirm AML checks were done on account creation?

maria-ops: AML completed at onboarding. Customer MID: VIST-992; KYC doc present.

billing-bot: Auto-retry scheduled in 2h (1723457489). This is attempt 1 of 3.

nolans: Customer asked for a quicker option — can someone send the wire template now and flag approval thread?

maria-ops: Pasting redacted wire details below for customer. Please don't share outside this thread.

```
Beneficiary: Redwood Inference, Inc.
Bank: Acme Bank, NA
Routing (ACH): 111000025
Account: ****6789
Reference: INV-2573 / Vistara Health
```

elena-sales: Sending to the customer now. I'll note the approval requirement. :thumbsup:

samir: I'll hold off on automatic retries while wire is in flight, so we don't overcharge or double-collect. If wire arrives, mark invoice paid and cancel retries.

maria-ops: @kevin-legal please confirm sign-off for >$10k wire acceptance?

kevin-legal: Confirmed. Approve to accept wire for INV-2573. Recommend flagging account for 72h after receipt for reconciliation.

nolans: Thanks — I'll update the ticket and add the wire ETA from customer. If it doesn't land by EOD tomorrow, proceed with retry plan.

elena-sales: Customer replied: sending today via treasury team, ETA 24-48h. Will update. :party_parrot:

billing-bot: Payment status changed: pending_wire -> awaiting_reconciliation.

maria-ops: Closing loop here — keep updates short. If we need to trigger refunds or disputes, we'll open a new thread.
